name: tfmcp
description: 🌍 Terraform Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool - An experimental CLI tool that enables AI assistants to manage and operate Terraform environments. Supports reading Terraform configurations, analyzing plans, applying configurations, and managing state with Claude Desktop integration. ⚡️

analysis.summary_en: ⚠️ This project includes production-ready security features but is still under active development.
highlights: MCPRATELIMITSESSION: Maximum HTTP requests per minute per Mcp-Session-Id (0 or unset disables).
MCPSESSIONMODE: stateful for normal MCP clients or stateless for CI-style JSON responses (default: stateful).
RMCP 3.5.0, updated dependencies and images, with the Rust 1.88 MSRV retained
TRANSPORT_HOST: HTTP bind host for streamable HTTP mode (default: 127.0.0.1).
